en: Black‑and‑white image of a cobblestoned town square bordered by low historic buildings with gabled roofs. The left side shows a row of two‑story houses with shop signs; the right side has several large trees with benches or carts underneath. In the background, across the square, stand more houses with arcaded gateways and German‑language business signage. A church steeple rises behind the roofs. The image has the appearance of an early 20th‑century postcard photograph of a Central European market square.
